prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t say one single company is objectively “the best” for everyone, but I can point you to several highly rated HVAC companies that serve Houston and give you tips to pick the right one for your situation. If you tell me your ZIP code or neighborhood (and whether it’s an emergency, residential vs. commercial, or under warranty), I can recommend the best nearby options.

Reputable Houston-area companies to consider
- John Moore Services — Large local company with wide service area, maintenance plans, and emergency response.
- Baker Brothers Plumbing, AC & Electric — Houston-based, well-reviewed for residential emergency AC repairs.
- One Hour Heating & Air Conditioning (local franchise) — National franchise with local technicians and on-time guarantees.
- ARS/Rescue Rooter — National player with broad resources and emergency crews in many areas around Houston.
- Service Experts Heating & Air Conditioning (if available in your area) — National company with technician certifications and maintenance plans.

How to pick the best one for your repair
- Verify licensing/registration: Check the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR) to confirm the contractor is authorized to work on HVAC systems.
- Look for NATE-certified techs and manufacturer-authorized dealer status if your system is under warranty.
- Read recent local reviews (Google, Yelp, BBB) — pay attention to responses to complaints.
- Ask about emergency/after-hours availability and typical response time.
- Get at least two written estimates that list parts, labor, and warranties.
- Ask about service warranties, parts warranties, and whether they pull permits if required.
- Prefer flat-rate estimates over vague hourly pricing; ask for diagnostics fees upfront.
- Consider a maintenance plan if you want priority service and lower repair costs over time.

If you share your ZIP code or neighborhood and whether this is an emergency, I’ll give 2–3 best options close to you plus current phone numbers and what to ask when they arrive.
